stemMarkdown: The speed of a boat in still water is 10 km/h and the speed of the stream is 5 km/h. How many hours does the boat take to travel 60 km downstream? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Downstream the current helps, so the effective speed is $10 + 5 = 15$ km/h. Time $= \dfrac{60}{15} = 4.0$ hours.
